Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter to target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1938222', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
